requirement: Agent demo freezes research, scopes private access and guards planned media import and replay

oracle.invariant: Full source and media catalogue is hashed and paginated beyond asset24. Provision-only requires a frozen server revision and active action. Foreign account/site/session and arbitrary URL imports are refused. Plan persists before writes; revocation, Stop, corrupt bytes and uncertain receipts block later writes. Confirmed import replay returns its existing receipt without a second upload.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command

writes: run dir under QA_ARTIFACT_ROOT: logs/, tmp/<case> (the child TMPDIR, removed after the run)
